description: This Java class 'ExampleAgent' extends BackupAgent and implements backup and restore logic for a sample Android application. It manages small data consisting of booleans and an integer, handling backup and restore operations with versioning and state tracking.

classes.name: ExampleAgent
classes.description: An Android BackupAgent subclass that handles backup and restore of a small dataset, illustrating manual backup logic without helper classes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the data file location based on application context.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Performs backup of current application data, comparing with previous state to avoid redundant backups.

methods.name: compareStateFile
methods.description: Reads previous backup state and determines if data has changed to decide whether to proceed with backup.

methods.name: writeStateFile
methods.description: Writes current data state and version into the state file for future comparisons.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Restores application data from backup, reconstructing the data file from the stored backup data.
